QuestInfo.name: [Freud's Journal] The Ring's Second Step
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Arnello. He wants to help you with the second step of growing your ring.\r\n\r\n#rCaution! You must have the Sylph Ring in your inventory when you complete the quest.
QuestInfo.1: According to the Ring Growth Manual, the second thing you need to do is to overcome an ordeal together. Arnello says you should defeat Normal Zakum once.\r\n\r\n#rCaution! You must have the Sylph Ring in your inventory when you complete the quest.
QuestInfo.2: After you defeated Normal Zakum, the ring transformed and shared its last memory of Freud. While Freud was on a journey, he met a young citizen fighting to protect their town. He decided to give the ring to that person.
